title: Ahrefs—AI Marketing Platform Powered by Big Data

facts.fact: Ahrefs reports that 26,894 users joined Ahrefs in the last 7 days.
facts.quote: 26894 users joined Ahrefs in the last 7 days

facts.fact: Ahrefs states that marketers at 44% of the Fortune 500 use Ahrefs.
facts.quote: Marketers at 44% of the Fortune 500 use Ahrefs to stay ahead in search and AI.

facts.fact: Ahrefs states that Ask Ahrefs, its built-in AI assistant, is free during beta on Lite+ plans.
facts.quote: Free during beta on Lite+ plans. Already in your Ahrefs.

facts.fact: Ahrefs states that its in-house supercomputer ranks #34 on the TOP500 list (June 2024 edition).
Ahrefs states it covers 217+ countries and locations.
Ahrefs states it has filtered 28.7B keywords from 110B discovered.
Ahrefs states its web index contains 100B pages.
Ahrefs states AhrefsBot crawls 8B pages daily.
Ahrefs states its engineers have spent 15+ years building its search dataset.
facts.quote: The same engineers who spent 15+ years building the most comprehensive search dataset

facts.fact: Ahrefs reports a 91.2% customer support satisfaction rating.
Ahrefs reports a median first support response time of 5:58 (unit shown as M).
Ahrefs states its customer support is available 5 days a week.
facts.quote: available 5 days a week when you need it most.

facts.fact: Ahrefs' Suso Digital testimonial reports 21,000+ monthly clicks in business-relevant keywords.
facts.quote: 21,000+ monthly clicks in business relevant keywords

facts.fact: Ahrefs offers 100+ flexible API endpoints for custom dashboards and reporting.
Ahrefs states it is ISO27001 certified.
